llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose (generate stock reports, produce images, and optionally push them); required operations and files are proportional to the task.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, code files (generate_report.py, scheduling and push scripts), and instructions align: the skill fetches public market data, generates charts/images, and can push via openclaw/Feishu. It does not request unrelated credentials or unusual system access.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and scripts instruct network requests to public market APIs (sina/eastmoney/tx) and producing HTML/PNG outputs — expected. Push scripts use the 'openclaw message' CLI to send images to Feishu; this will transmit generated report images to whatever target is configured. The push behavior is explicit in the docs and scripts (config.json or hardcoded target). If you do not want remote delivery, avoid running the push scripts or edit the target.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No registry install spec, but an included install.sh will run pip installs (matplotlib, pyppeteer), attempt to install system fonts via apt/yum/dnf/pacman (requires sudo), and pre-download Chromium via pyppeteer. These are standard for image generation but require network access and, for fonts, elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not declare or require environment variables or credentials. It relies on the user's openclaw/Feishu configuration for push functionality (the scripts call the openclaw CLI). That is reasonable — the skill expects the user to have messaging credentials configured separately rather than embedding secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request 'always: true' or attempt to modify other skills or system-wide agent settings. It installs dependencies into user/system package managers and writes logs to /tmp, which is appropriate for this kind of tool.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: fetch public market data, render charts, and optionally push the results. Before installing, consider: 1) install.sh will call system package managers and may use sudo to install fonts — review the script and run it manually if you are uncomfortable with automatic sudo operations; 2) pyppeteer will download Chromium (large download) — allow network access or skip pre-download; 3) the push scripts use the openclaw CLI to send images to Feishu (reads target from config.json or uses a hardcoded placeholder in schedule_push.py) — ensure you control the configured target and that openclaw is properly authenticated; 4) if you only want local report generation, do not run the push scripts or remove the openclaw/send calls. Review config.json for any customized targets before enabling scheduled pushes.
